column1: # arc12-ablation v1 (ARC12 relation-diff edit vs the raw coordinate table)
# Both arms run the same plan and the same SP5 solve; one row per AB1 brief.
#     requests = relation request lines the brief asks for (one per want)
#     changes = relation delta lines the solve produced (added+removed+relabel)
#     raw_lanes / raw_bytes = the coordinate table the parent report carries
#     edit_bytes = bytes of the request plus change lines
#     digest_equal = 1 when the edit's spine writes carry the exact level digest
# The units a caller authors are `requests` relation lines and reviews
# `changes` relation lines; the raw arm would make the caller author
# `raw_lanes` loose coordinate numbers with no relation meaning. `edit_bytes`
# is recorded, not compared: words cost more bytes than floats, and the
# ablation claim is losslessness plus authorable units, never a byte win.
